This role is essential to ensuring that our organization's AI and data practices adhere to the highest ethical standards and comply with applicable regulations and policies. Position Details EYs GDS Assurance Digital teams mission is to develop, implement and integrate technology solutions that better serve our audit clients and engagement teams. Requirements Education & Experience Bachelors or Masters degree in a field such as Computer Science, Data Science, Ethics, Law, or a combination of technology and law. 5 - 7 years of relevant experience. Regulatory Knowledge: Familiarity with relevant AI regulations and compliance requirements across major jurisdictions. Technical Knowledge: Familiarity with data science and/or machine learning, Generative AI concepts is a must. Communication Skills: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and influence diverse stakeholders. Analytical Skills: Analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and mitigate risks. Project Management: Strong project management skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a team. Responsibilities Risk Assessment: Conduct risk assessments to identify potential ethical, legal, and reputational risks associated with AI use. Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate with internal stakeholders (e.g., engineers, data scientists, product managers) to integrate AI governance principles into project development and deployment. Monitoring and Auditing: Monitor and audit compliance of products with AI policies and procedures. Metrics Development: Develop and implement metrics to track and measure the effectiveness of AI governance initiatives. Communication: Communicate complex AI governance issues clearly and concisely to both technical and non-technical audiences. Ethical Development: Champion the ethical development and implementation of AI models, ensuring adherence to regulatory guidelines. Continuous Learning: Foster a culture of continuous learning and awareness around AI regulations and compliance within the organization. Additional Skills Requirements Interest in Politics and Legislation: Strong interest in politics and legislation within data and AI. title: PPC Executive
description:
Job Summary We are looking for an enthusiastic and detail-oriented Business Analyst - Fresher to support business analysis, requirements gathering, documentation, and coordination across technical and business teams. The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, an analytical mindset, and an interest in understanding business needs and translating them into clear project requirements. The ideal candidate should be interested in Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, AI chatbots, and digital products , with the ability to understand business needs and translate them into clear product requirements. Strong verbal and written communication skills are essential. Responsibilities Understand business objectives, user needs, and use cases for AI-powered products. Assist in gathering, analyzing, and documenting product and business requirements. Support the preparation of BRDs, FRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows. Research AI, Generative AI, chatbot, and automation use cases. Assist in defining chatbot workflows, user journeys, intents, responses, and escalation scenarios. Coordinate with Product Managers, developers, AI/ML teams, QA testers, designers, and other stakeholders. Participate in client discussions and requirement clarification meetings. Prepare meeting minutes, requirement notes, project updates, and action-item trackers. Assist in evaluating AI product outputs for relevance, accuracy, consistency, and user experience. Support prompt testing, prompt documentation, and basic prompt improvement activities. Help identify gaps, issues, dependencies, and opportunities for product enhancement. Validate developed features against documented requirements. Conduct basic competitor, market, and user research related to AI products. Prepare presentations, reports, and product documentation for internal and client discussions. Required Skills Strong verbal and written communication skills. Good analytical, logical, and problem-solving abilities. Ability to understand business processes and document requirements clearly. Good listening, questioning, coordination, and follow-up skills. Basic knowledge of software development or IT project workflows. Familiarity with SDLC, Agile, or Scrum will be an advantage. Basic knowledge of MS Excel, Google Sheets, PowerPoint, and documentation tools. Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn. Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Educational Qualifications Candidates who graduated in 2025 or 2026 from the following backgrounds are preferred: B.Tech/B.E. - Computer Science B.Tech/B.E. - Information Technology MCA BCA B.Sc. - Computer Science, IT, or a related discipline Preferred Candidate Profile Fresher with a genuine interest in AI products and business analysis. Confident communicator with good presentation and interpersonal skills. Curious about how AI-powered products solve business and customer problems. Comfortable working with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Able to learn new AI tools and understand product use cases. Organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and willing to work from the Kolkata office.
